(Search snippet content — House of Commons Library / Home Office / BBC, 2026; own reporting language)

UK small-boat Channel crossings, 2026:
- The 25,000 mark for migrants reaching the UK in small boats was passed at the end of July 2026, much earlier than in previous years (the pre-2025 record year, 2022, did not pass the mark until 27 August).
- A single boat carrying a record 125 migrants crossed the Channel; 1,195 people arrived in 19 boats in one day in June.
- The UK–France "one in, one out" returns scheme: for each migrant the UK returns to France, a person with a strong asylum case is allowed to come to the UK. Introduced as a pilot in August 2025.
- As of early March 2026, the Home Office reported 377 people returned to France and 380 arrived in the UK under the scheme.
- Reform UK (Nigel Farage) announced on 3 August 2026 an "Operation Fortress" plan: the "largest military operation in the Channel since World War Two" to intercept and return small-boat arrivals to France.
